Explore the measured changes

Mean and approximate 95% t interval across training seeds; fixed datasets and corruption realisations. NLL change: positive means improvement. ECE change: positive means deterioration. Consider absolute performance alongside changes.

Reliability explorer

One model and training seed at a time. The diagonal represents perfect agreement between confidence and observed accuracy. Empty bins are omitted. Temperature was fitted once on clean calibration data and held fixed.

Primary paired comparisons

Positive mean favours the first model. Secondary two-sided sign-flip tests on midranks; Holm adjustment across these three comparisons. Null inference assumes symmetric, independent seed differences.

Interpretation and provenance

  • No temperature boundary flags.

Clean data already contains 5% expected numerical missingness. Deleted events retain surviving source time fields. Labels refer to the original sequence. Distinct severity files are not nested perturbations.

Retention diagnostics are descriptive, not causal. Undefined scores are represented by NaN in prediction archives and null in JSON, with eligibility counts. Confidence intervals do not include uncertainty from resampling datasets or corruption realisations.

Full numerical evidence is in the adjacent JSON, CSV and prediction archives. Static figures are supplied as PNG, SVG and PDF.
